title: Flow Spotlight Number Slider
description: When double-clicking flow canvas and typing a number in spotlight, automatically create a slider with a sensible range. When typing a range like 10.2..15, create a slider with exactly that min/max and step precision matching decimal places.
summary: Flow spotlight now creates widgets from typed input: numbers/ranges become sliders with sensible or explicit bounds; free text like 'some text' becomes input notes when no catalogue match (function search like 'mul' still finds catalogue items). InputNote descriptors accept optional text. Tests: flow core 28 pass, flow react 50 pass.
